titulo.estudio: Un formulaire administratif : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: An administrative form: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Make sense of fields, instructions and documents that go with an application. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Make sense of fields, instructions and documents that go with an application. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: infinitives in instructions name actions; « obligatoire » and « facultatif » separate a requirement from an option. In this passage, «justificatif» means «supporting document».

frases.estudio: Le justificatif de domicile est obligatoire; une photo récente est facultative.
frases.alumno: The proof of address is compulsory; a recent photo is optional.

frases.estudio: Joignez les deux documents à votre dossier avant le 30 septembre.
frases.alumno: Attach both documents to your file before 30 September.
